messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
I don’t have access to live databases right now, so I can’t pull the exact numbers for you at this moment.  
Historically, **Kevin De Bruyne** has been the Premier‑League record holder for most assists over multiple seasons – he topped the charts in 2018–19, 2019–20, 2020–21, 2022–23 and again in 2023–24.  

If you’re looking for the *current* leader for a specific season (e.g., 2025–26), you’ll need to check the latest statistics from:

| Source | How to find it |
|--------|----------------|
| Official Premier League website | “Stats” → “Assists” filter |
| Opta / StatsBomb dashboards | Search “Premier League assists leaderboard” |
| Sports news outlets (ESPN, BBC Sport) | Look under “Top Assist Providers” |

Feel free to let me know which season you’re interested in, and I can point you toward the precise figures once you’ve checked one of those resources!

We could respond acknowledging limitation and provide best guess based on knowledge up to 2025. Provide context about typical leaders (Kevin De Bruyne historically). Also mention that official stats may vary per season. Could ask clarifying question if they mean a particular season. Or give general info.
